comment: vouchfx — injects VSCode's built-in C# TextMate grammar (source.cs) into the YAML block scalar that follows a `code:` mapping key. The `code:` field is where a `script.csharp` step carries its author C#. Boundary rule: the body is the run of lines more-indented than the `code:` key, terminating at the first non-blank line indented at or below the key (the YAML block-scalar indentation rule), which the `while` clause enforces via the captured key indentation.

csharp-code-block.comment: Match a `code:` key whose value is a block scalar (| |- |+ > >- >+, with an optional explicit indentation digit), then keep every subsequent line that is blank or more-indented than the key as embedded C#. Capture group 1 is the key's leading indentation; the `while` backreference \1 plus a required extra indent character enforces the dedent boundary.
